tagline: The checks only you can run, as a list you tick off
use_when: Claude shipped something it could not fully test itself, on a real phone, with real data or against a service it cannot reach, and you want the checks as a short list you work through rather than instructions that scroll away in chat.
try_it: Use /proofs:qa-checklist to list the checks I need to run on what you just shipped.

features.label: Pass, Fail or Couldn't Test
features.title: One answer per check
features.what: Each check has three answers, including the honest one for a check blocked by an earlier failure.
features.html:
Delete a clip that made a recommendation
Expected: it deletes cleanly.
PassFailCouldn't test

features.label: Most Important First
features.sub: Checks are ordered by what a failure would cost
features.title: Checks are ordered by what a failure would cost
features.what: A crash or lost data comes first, so the checks that matter most get done even if you stop halfway.
features.html:
1 · Delete an orderlost data
2 · Pay on a phonecrash
3 · Receipt fontlooks off

features.label: What Pass Looks Like
features.sub: Every check says what you should see
features.title: Every check says what you should see
features.what: Each check names the expected result and why it is on the list, and asks for the exact evidence Claude needs if it fails.
features.html:
Open the receipt on your phone
Expected: the total matches the cart.
If it fails: paste the order number

features.label: Why Claude Couldn't Check It
features.sub: Each check says what stopped Claude
features.title: Each check says what stopped Claude
features.what: A check is on your list because Claude could not run it: no real phone, no live data, a service it cannot reach. Each one says which.
features.html:
Pay on a phoneno real phone
Refund a cardno live data

features.label: Not a Bug, Not Built Yet
features.sub: What will look broken is named up front
features.title: What will look broken is named up front
features.what: If something will look broken but simply isn't built yet, the page says so, so it doesn't come back as a bug report.
features.html:
Expected, not a bug
The Export button is gray: export comes next week.

features.label: Results in One Paste
features.sub: Copy my results sends them all back
features.title: Copy my results sends them all back
features.what: One button copies every result and note, with anything you have not reached marked as not checked.
features.html:
QA qa-delete-order
  -> PASS
QA qa-receipt
  -> (NOT CHECKED)

features.label: Where the Page Goes
features.sub: A private link, a local file, or your Wi-Fi
features.title: A private link, a local file, or your Wi-Fi
features.what: Your project picks where review pages go: a private claude.ai link, an HTML file that opens in your browser, or that file served on your home Wi-Fi so a phone can open it. Nothing is ever uploaded or tunneled in the Wi-Fi mode, and the server stops when the review ends.
